rule: Allow one encoded step (1/254). Public contracts assert exact encoded integers.
Allow half a display step: temperature 0.05 C, humidity 0.5 percent, cover position 0.005. Public contracts assert exact Matter values.
Select cooling and match target_temperature at the same endpoint/cluster to the separate cooling target. Verify reverse control reaches target_temperature.cool.
Match backend alarm_motion at the same endpoint/cluster; require the identical boolean value.
Backend maps null to false. Only null receives this allowance; public assertions require null to stay unknown.
Backend applies the logarithm to Matter's special 0 and reports 10^(-1/10000) lux. Only input zero receives this allowance; public assertions require encoded 0. Other vectors allow 0.001 lux.

Allow half a percent step (0.005 normalized). PercentCurrent is compared with the backend percentSetting projection only because both values have independent identical source-report contracts. When switched off, percentSetting/Current report zero while the source can retain a remembered speed; this state coupling is tested independently.
Matter encodes percentage in half-percent steps; allow 0.5 percentage point for backend rounding. Public tests require exact 0–200 integers and null unknown readings.
Match meter_power on the same endpoint/cluster, with identical kWh values. No summing tariff or daily subtotals.
The backend formats meter_power to three decimals in kWh. Allow half a display step, 0.0005 kWh. Public contracts still assert exact mWh integers, including 64-bit TLV values.

The bridge uses the Homey OS fallback range 153–400 mired for normalized sources without physical limits. Allow one mired step (1/247) on round trips; the backend no longer clamps or collapses source values. This is a declared fallback, not calibrated physical lamp metadata.

The pinned backend stores voltage/current to two decimals in V/A. Allow half that display step (0.005) only in backend reconstruction. Independent Matter checks retain exact mV/mA, including 230.125 V -> 230125 mV and 1.234 A -> 1234 mA. The same tolerance applies to standard sub-capabilities matched by endpoint and cluster.

When exactly two matching power capabilities share endpoint/cluster provenance, the pinned backend creates measure_power as a sibling sum and measure_power.matter-<endpoint>-144 as the physical channel reading. Select the latter for channel comparison; do not allow numeric tolerance or match the aggregate to a source channel. No polyphase feature is inferred. A mixed fixture independently asserts two 12 W channels rather than a 24 W channel.
